summary: Karman Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Walker Precision Engineering for approximately $95 million in cash, subject to customary adjustments, via a wholly owned subsidiary. To fund the deal, Karman entered a Sixth Amendment to its Credit Agreement, increasing term loans by $100 million to a total original principal of $863.961 million, and will use proceeds for the purchase and related fees. The filing also discloses the credit facility modification and provides an update on the transaction. No advisors or premium details are mentioned. Watch for integration progress and any post-closing adjustments.
